harness.next.label: Next start
harness.next.hint: `daoris agent profile use {{agent}}{{scoped}}` prints the steps the next start follows
harness.next.whyGoal: Each start walks this list: driven work passes the account kept for conversations, and an account its agent said is near its limit goes last; then the account running the fewest of Daoris's sessions, then one whose week resets within a day, then the one furthest behind its week's pace, then the one Daoris started on least recently, then the list's order. The first ready account runs: not cooling, not refused, and signed in.
harness.next.whyOrder: Each start runs on the first ready account in the list's order, begun at its default; with Switch before the limit on, an account its agent said is near its limit goes last. Driven work passes the account kept for conversations.
harness.next.own: The next start runs on your own sign-in: nothing here names an account.
harness.next.waitsUntil: No account here is ready, so the next start waits until {{when}}.
harness.next.waits: No account here is ready, and none comes ready by itself: the next start waits for you.
harness.next.why.named: it is the one account used here
harness.next.why.onlyReady: it is the only account here that is ready
harness.next.why.keptOver: {{over}} is kept for conversations, which take it last
harness.next.why.near: {{over}} is near its limit, so it goes last
harness.next.why.fewest: it runs fewer of Daoris's sessions than {{over}}
harness.next.why.lapsingSoon: its week resets first, within a day
harness.next.why.pace: it is further behind its week's pace than {{over}}
harness.next.why.leastRecent: Daoris started on it less recently than {{over}}
harness.next.why.notStarted: Daoris has not started on it yet
harness.next.why.listFirst: it comes first in the list
harness.next.why.listNext: it comes before {{over}} in the list
harness.next.ownSignIn: {{product}}'s own sign-in, the account it uses at your terminal, carries none of these starts: they run only on the accounts used here, and it runs only starts where nothing names an account.
